_comment: Expected shape for check_expected_preflight.py. The asserter verifies the structural contract of preflight-report.json (not exact values — those come from a live doc-lookup run). It runs as a SMOKE asserter: no golden run dir is committed, so it verifies the failure path on an empty dir.
status_consistency: if blockers is non-empty then status must be blocked; if blockers is empty and quota_items is non-empty then status must be warn; if both are empty then status must be pass
